answer: To enter voting, an agent must lock a bond priced in saffron that cannot be withdrawn across a dune of successive epochs. Influence stays zero until a public beacon fires: a threshold of settlements completed with already-established, unlinked counterparties, all signed under one custody key. If two keys later merge, or a cluster of aliases is caught sharing counterparties, the bond is slashed and both records go dark. A farm of fresh keys therefore burns real locked capital with no early influence.
